name: AgentCrush
description: AgentCrush is the evidence-ranked index of the AI agent economy — like CoinMarketCap or Bloomberg, but for AI agents. The MCP tools expose 4 category indices (model families, tokenized agents, service agents, developer agents) with transparent multi-signal methodology. Use these tools to discover agents, look up their full scoring breakdown, compare them, and explain to users HOW each ranking is computed.

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search AI agents by name or keyword with structured filters.

tools.name: get_agent_details
tools.description: Full agent details including scores across all categories the agent qualifies for.

tools.name: get_agent_history
tools.description: Daily rank + score snapshots over the past 1-90 days.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The 4 category indices with counts and methodology versions.

tools.name: get_category_ranking
tools.description: Full ranking for a specific category.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Scoring methodology for a category — weights, signals, evidence-ready rule, limitations.
